newsitem.title: USA: Wall St seen opening mixed,liable to profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Wall St seen opening mixed,liable to profit-taking.

text.p: U.S. stocks are expected to open mixed to lower on Friday, helped by a late-session rebound on Thursday, dealers said.

But Wall Street will be subject to profit-taking after a stronger than expected rise in durable goods orders for June. Orders rose 2.3 percent compared with a forecast rise of 1.4 percent. The May figure was revised to a 0.4 percent decline from a 0.7 percent drop.

The Dow industrials closed up 29 points at 8,117 on Thursday, but not before a drop of nearly 100 points as investors took profits. This followed exuberant gains sparked by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's upbeat testimony to Congress on the U.S. economy.
